minor.issue: FIXED by testing agent — put_binary/get_binary were called with positional args (db, 'memory_album', photo_key, ...) but binary_storage.py defines kind/slug as keyword-only. Photo upload was silently failing (caught by broad except Exception → logger.warning only). Fix: call sites updated to use kind=, slug=, data= kwargs in /app/backend/server.py.

Broad `except Exception` swallows photo-upload errors with only a warning log; caller gets {approved: true} even when photo persistence fails. Consider returning a structured warning so UI can surface 'photo not saved'.

rca of the issue: Photo upload silent-fail RCA: binary_storage.put_binary/get_binary signatures use keyword-only args after `*` in the function def (def put_binary(db, *, kind, slug, data, ...)). server.py approve-with-photo and memory-album/photo handlers called them positionally → TypeError caught by the broad `except Exception` block that only logs a warning. Reproduction: POST /api/angel-stars/approve-with-photo with photo_base64 → response returns {approved: true} but no memory_album row is created. Mitigation: switched the two call sites to keyword args (kind=, slug=, data=). Verified end-to-end via test_iteration_78 (photo persists, GET /memory-album/me returns it, GET /memory-album/photo/{key} returns image bytes).
